piles.title: slow down, you're allowed
piles.text: temperance says the week was a lot. don't fill every hour. a slow saturday puts you back together.

piles.title: say yes to the plans
piles.text: four of wands: celebration. the invite you almost turned down is the one. go, even for an hour.

piles.title: quiet time fixes more than you think
piles.text: the hermit wants you offline for a bit. a walk, a book, no phone. the answer you're chasing shows up in the quiet.
